survivors.claim: In the new vm case, only the second-run hide assertion is the discriminating pin. The load-time 'shown' assertion (projwait.hidden === false) passes even with setHidden(projwait, !showProjwait) removed, because the flat-DOM element's hidden defaults to false; and the textContent assertion passes even when recount() never writes it, because the server already emitted the identical string. The failure message on the text assertion ('not merely leave the server's original text untouched') therefore overclaims what the assertion proves. The pin is non-vacuous overall, so this is calibration of the test's own messages, not a gap.
survivors.impact: A future reader trusting the assertion messages would believe the show half and the text-rewrite are pinned when only the hide half actually is; a regression that stops the browser showing the line at load would go unnoticed by this test.
